mapper.sql: FROM company_bid_notice_state state JOIN bid_notice notice ON notice.bid_notice_id = state.bid_notice_id AND notice.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN crawl_source source ON source.crawl_source_id = notice.crawl_source_id AND source.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN business_category category ON category.business_category_id = notice.business_category_id AND category.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT notice.bid_notice_id AS notice_id, notice.notice_name, source.source_code, source.source_name, notice.source_url, notice.notice_agency, notice.business_category_id, category.name AS business_category_name, notice.base_amount, notice.estimated_amount, notice.announced_at, notice.bid_deadline_at, NULL AS d_day, CASE WHEN state.first_seen_run_id = ( SELECT MAX(latest_run.crawl_run_id) FROM crawl_run latest_run JOIN crawl_condition latest_condition ON latest_condition.crawl_condition_id = latest_run.crawl_condition_id WHERE latest_condition.company_id = #{companyId} AND latest_run.run_status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS') AND latest_run.deleted_at IS NULL ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_new, state.notice_status, ( SELECT MIN(project_table.project_id) FROM project project_table JOIN employee creator ON creator.user_id = project_table.created_by WHERE project_table.bid_notice_id = notice.bid_notice_id AND creator.company_id = #{companyId} AND project_table.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS project_id
ORDER BY notice.bid_deadline_at IS NULL, notice.bid_deadline_at ASC, notice.bid_notice_id DESC
ORDER BY notice.estimated_amount IS NULL, notice.estimated_amount DESC, notice.bid_notice_id DESC
ORDER BY notice.announced_at DESC, notice.bid_notice_id DESC
LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT notice.bid_notice_id AS notice_id, notice.external_id, notice.notice_ord AS notice_order, notice.notice_name, notice.notice_type, notice.external_notice_status, notice.notice_agency, notice.demand_agency, state.notice_status, state.dismiss_reason, ( SELECT MIN(project_table.project_id) FROM project project_table JOIN employee creator ON creator.user_id = project_table.created_by WHERE project_table.bid_notice_id = notice.bid_notice_id AND creator.company_id = #{companyId} AND project_table.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS project_id, source.source_code, source.source_name, notice.source_url, notice.has_attachment, notice.announced_at, notice.bid_start_at, notice.question_deadline_at, notice.application_deadline_at, notice.bid_deadline_at, notice.opening_at, NULL AS d_day, notice.base_amount, notice.estimated_amount, notice.price_range_text, notice.minimum_bid_rate_text, notice.participation_qualification_text, notice.region_limit_text, notice.business_limit_text, notice.joint_contract_allowed, notice.joint_contract_text, notice.contract_method, notice.evaluation_method FROM company_bid_notice_state state JOIN bid_notice notice ON notice.bid_notice_id = state.bid_notice_id AND notice.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN crawl_source source ON source.crawl_source_id = notice.crawl_source_id AND source.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE state.company_id = #{companyId} AND state.bid_notice_id = #{noticeId}
SELECT attachment_order, file_name, source_url FROM bid_notice_attachment WHERE bid_notice_id = #{noticeId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY attachment_order ASC
